review_fix_red_green.red: CLI status mapping previously returned process success when cleanup changed the result to FAIL; a new fake retained-process case makes run_arm produce FAIL with native_exit_observed=false.
review_fix_red_green.green: main now exits zero only for PASS and returns nonzero otherwise; tests preserve measured request counts, native-exit boolean, and the persisted report summary.

review_fix_red_green.red: An injected original startup failure plus coordinator.close failure previously prevented final result.json persistence and risked masking the original error.
review_fix_red_green.green: Nested cleanup captures cleanup errors, persists FAIL and numeric receipts, then rethrows the original run error. Separate coverage verifies a close-only failure after nine completed samples also persists FAIL.

review_fix_red_green.red: Long startup/import/request phases previously had no heartbeat or phase context.
review_fix_red_green.green: A 30-second heartbeat writes PID, phase, root, repeat, and elapsed time; incremental result.json phase/sample updates remain. Tests check heartbeat context, clean thread stop, and that background emit failures cause a harness failure.

review_fix_red_green.red: A runner exception could summarize a pre-existing PASS result as successful, and a heartbeat thread write failure could disappear without failing the harness.
review_fix_red_green.green: CLI exception handling always returns FAIL, records the pre-existing status and invocation error, and leaves an old result file byte-for-byte untouched. The heartbeat worker error is retained and raised by close(). Regressions cover old PASS refusal and worker emit failure.

review_fix_red_green.red: Native process cleanup treated any observed exit, including signal/nonzero exit, as success.
review_fix_red_green.green: Reports now include native_exit_codes and PASS requires each observed code to be zero. CPU regression injects -9 and verifies FAIL; no native process was launched for this test.

review_fix_red_green.red: Input acceptance allowed fixture root mapping to be inferred and did not require actual 65,536-token prepared histories.
review_fix_red_green.green: Production inputs now require three roots with 65,536 history tokens each and an explicit six-tree map; selected trees 0/2/4 must map to roots 0/1/2. CPU fixture uses an explicit test-only 256-token override and rejects the override without an injected fake coordinator.
Module docstring now distinguishes import from the explicit CLI runner that imports checkpoints and starts a coordinator.
